Messages.Author: Ped Xing
Messages.Body:
Relevant Card Texts:

Gisela Harden, The Winnower (7)
aus dem FOR NEC
Harbinger of Skulls
Sabbat Priscus: Gisela can burn a vampire in your prey's uncontrolled
region as a (D) action that costs X blood, where X is the amount of
blood on that vampire; any blood on that vampire is returned to your
prey's pool.

Daemonic Possession
Action, Necromancy, 2 Blood
[nec] Only usable when a minion controlled by another Methuselah has
been burned since your last turn. Move that minion from his owner's
ash heap to your ready region, put 1 blood or life from the blood bank
on the minion and tap the minion. You now control the minion. [NEC] As
above, but the minion is untapped.

Some quick questions:
1) Can Daemonic Possession be used to recruit vamps burned by Gisela's
special ability?

2) How does the NRA rule apply to Gisela's special ability--can she
use it more than once per turn? (I supposed I am confused since the
new NRA rule still prohibits special ability defined actions with the
exception of Blanche Hill who can hunt more than once a turn.)

Thanks again,
Matthew Scrivner
Anarch of the Sonoran Desert

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
On 12 Oct 2002 15:32:05 -0700, ped_...@hotmail.com (Ped Xing) wrote:

>Some quick questions:
>1) Can Daemonic Possession be used to recruit vamps burned by Gisela's
>special ability?

No.

Relevant card text on Daemonic Possession:
"controlled by another Methuselah"

Vampires in the uncontrolled region are not "controlled by another
Methuselah".

LSJ 2002-06-22
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3D14BCDB.3E0424C6%40white-wolf.com

LSJ 2002-02-08
http://groups.google.com/groups?selm=3C63F473.FB54FF12%40white-wolf.com

>2) How does the NRA rule apply to Gisela's special ability--can she
>use it more than once per turn?

No, she cannot do her special more than once per turn. Her special is
an action granted by a card in play, so is prohibited by the rules,
section 6.1.6 on page 25 of the Camarilla Edition rulebook.

"A minion cannot perform an action with the same action
card or via the same card in play (including from the minion’s
own card text) more than once each turn, even if he untaps."

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

Messages.Author: The Bard of Crete
Messages.Body:
> 2) How does the NRA rule apply to Gisela's special ability--can she
> use it more than once per turn? (I supposed I am confused since the
> new NRA rule still prohibits special ability defined actions with the
> exception of Blanche Hill who can hunt more than once a turn.)
>

Blanche Hill is not an exception. She can only use her ability once per
turn, by text, but even without the "once per turn" restriction, she could
only UNTAP once per turn.

So she can hunt, untap, and then hunt again, but not untap again....
